notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four artifacts.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Composite Golem from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Composite Golem from your hand by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.
